summary: Aeon Acquisition I Corp., a blank-check SPAC, filed an 8-K announcing that its units may separately trade into Class A ordinary shares, warrants, and rights starting July 1, 2026. This is a routine operational step following its IPO, not a special-situation event. No merger, acquisition, or corporate action involving terms or strategic change is disclosed. The units will continue trading under AESPU; the separated components under AESP, AESPW, AESPR. There is no deal, recommendation, or advisor. As this is a standard administrative filing for a SPAC, it does not meet special-situation criteria.
